title: What Does LALM Post-training Learn? Rethinking Audio Understanding and Reasoning Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2610.19476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training often improves the performance of large audio-language models on audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks. However, these improvements may reflect adaptation to specific question formats, such as multiple-choice questions, rather than genuine advances in audio understanding and reasoning capabilities. To investigate what LALMs actually learn from post-training, we conduct controlled experiments that disentangle improvements in audio understanding from adaptation to specific question formats. Across different models and post-training methods, we find that much of the reported improvement persists even without informative audio, but largely disappears when the question format changes. These findings suggest that post-training often teaches models to exploit task-specific textual cues and answer patterns rather than developing generalizable audio understanding and reasoning capabilities.

translated_title: LALM后训练究竟学到了什么？重新思考音频理解与推理能力
translated_abstract: 后训练通常会提升大型音频-语言模型（LALM）在音频理解与推理基准测试上的表现。然而，这些提升可能反映的是模型对特定问题格式（如多选题）的适应，而非音频理解与推理能力的真正进步。为了探究LALM从后训练中究竟学到了什么，我们进行了受控实验，将音频理解能力的提升与对特定问题格式的适应分离开来。在不同的模型和后训练方法上，我们发现即使没有提供有效的音频信息，许多所报告的性能提升依然存在；但当问题格式发生变化时，这些提升在很大程度上会消失。这些发现表明，后训练往往教会模型利用任务特定的文本线索和答案模式，而不是发展出可泛化的音频理解与推理能力。
tldr: 研究通过受控实验发现，大型音频-语言模型后训练带来的性能提升主要源于对特定问题格式和文本线索的适应，而非音频理解与推理能力的真正提升。
en_tdlr: This study reveals through controlled experiments that post-training improvements in large audio-language models largely stem from adaptation to specific question formats and textual cues rather than genuine gains in audio understanding and reasoning capabilities.
